Ian —

Received, thanks. Attaching the checklist I run through with finance when I kick vendor onboarding (copied Marissa and Priyom from Procure/FinOps). A couple of clarifying asks before we start:

1) Can you confirm the exact legal name you want on the payee record (Spruce Labs, Inc. vs Spruce Labs LLC)? This needs to match your W‑9 exactly.
2) Do you expect Redwood to send a PO number on all invoices, or will some invoices be submitted without a PO and require remittance matching via Invoice #?
3) For the remittance field, we prefer: Redwood PO#: [PO#######] OR Invoice#: [INV########]. If you can include an 8‑digit invoice number in your invoices, that will make automated reconciliation much easier.
4) If you opt for ACH, we will validate micro‑deposits. If you prefer wire, mark that in the bank letter and we will coordinate a one‑time test wire if needed.

Once Marissa confirms finance has what they need, we can finalize the NetSuite payee and enable PO routing. Quick timeline: finance typically validates within 48 business hours once micro‑deposits clear.

Jonas Weber
